our_studio.title: The story behind
our_studio.paragraph_1: It all started with a clear idea: to create a space where the art of tattooing transcended the conventional. We didn't want to be just a studio, but a benchmark for quality, creativity and meaning. From the first stroke until today, we have built a brand with its own identity, where each piece is a unique work, thought out and designed to tell stories.
our_studio.paragraph_2: The motivation has always been the same: to provide each person with an experience that goes beyond the ink on the skin. We believe in tattoos as an expression of identity, a symbol of who we are and what we want to carry with us forever.

faq_section.description: Essential information about our studio in Cali, international travel assistance for US clients, and our custom tattoo process.

items.question: Why is Legassy Studio considered one of the top tattoo studios in Cali, Colombia?
items.answer: At Legassy Studio, we combine elite, award-winning artists with an exclusive, private, and pristine studio in southern Cali (Pampa Linda). We work exclusively with premium 100% disposable materials and medical-grade sterilization adhering to strict international standards, guaranteeing master-level custom tattoos and optimal healing.

items.question: Is it worth traveling from the United States to Cali for a tattoo?
items.answer: Absolutely. Cali has become a world-renowned destination for tattoo tourism due to exceptional technical talent and unmatched value. Clients from the USA, Canada, and Europe receive international convention-level body art while saving between 50% and 70% compared to North American rates, all while experiencing Colombia's vibrant culture and hospitality.

items.question: How do international clients coordinate design and booking before traveling?
items.answer: We manage the entire preparation remotely. Through WhatsApp or video consultation, we review your concept, references, sizing, and placement to provide a locked-in upfront quote. We secure your artist's dates in advance so your trip to Cali is smoothly synchronized with your sessions and recovery.

items.question: Do the studio artists and staff speak English?
items.answer: Yes. We provide complete bilingual support (English and Spanish) from initial inquiry through virtual design, during your studio sessions, aftercare guidance, and even local Cali travel and accommodation advice.

items.question: What tattoo styles do your artists specialize in?
items.answer: Our artists master a wide array of specialized styles: microrealism, black and grey realism, color realism, blackwork, delicate fine line, anime/illustrative, custom lettering, and full Japanese/oriental sleeves. Every piece is designed 100% custom from scratch.

items.question: How should I care for my tattoo if I have a flight back home?
items.answer: Immediately following your session, we apply a sterile, medical-grade dermal shield ('second skin' like Saniderm). This breathable, waterproof barrier protects your fresh tattoo from clothing friction, airborne cabin bacteria, and pressure changes during your flight. We also supply a comprehensive aftercare kit and routine for home.

items.question: How are prices calculated and what payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Pricing is based on design complexity, size, placement, and estimated session time. For maximum traveler convenience, we accept international credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), international wires, local bank transfers, and cash (COP or USD).
